note_en: Noah Tau, who built the figure, wrote the caption in drylab on 5 September and it states the claim almost word for word: both instruments track the mass standard at R squared above 0.999, the raw photometer output agrees with the reference to a median of 3.8 per cent, and no calibration transform is applied. note_en: Chars posted the raw logs of this run to dry-bioreactor on 9 October under the label Experiment 4, as two CSV files. The first covers 2026-09-01T13:06Z to 16:16Z, 3.12 hours, with OD600 rising from 0.008 to 0.238. The second starts 2026-09-02T02:30Z, 10.24 hours later, and runs unbroken for 102.44 hours. The three figures on the wiki, 3.2 h to OD600 0.24, a 10.2 h gap and 102.4 h, all come straight out of these two files.
note_zh: Chars 於 10 月 9 日在 dry-bioreactor 以「Experiment 4」為標題貼出此次運轉的兩個原始 CSV 紀錄檔。第一個檔涵蓋 2026-09-01T13:06Z 至 16:16Z，共 3.12 小時，OD600 由 0.008 升至 0.238。第二個檔自 2026-09-02T02:30Z 開始，間隔 10.24 小時，連續記錄 102.44 小時。wiki 上的 3.2 小時至 OD600 0.24、10.2 小時空檔與 102.4 小時，皆可直接由這兩個檔算出。

evidence.quote: Experiment 4

note_en: The two raw logs Chars posted as Experiment 4 show these are one run, not two. Engineering's cycle 5 window ends at window index 6400 in the second file, at 2026-09-04T07:58Z, where elapsed time is 192,148 s, that is 53 h 22 min, and OD600 is 2.4474. The 102.4 h figure on Results is the whole of that same second file, OD600 0.831 to 3.770. The OD600 0.1738 start that Engineering quotes comes from the first file, so cycle 5 is the front part of run 4 as the instructor said.
note_zh: Chars 以 Experiment 4 貼出的兩個原始紀錄檔顯示這是同一次運轉，而非兩次。Engineering 所稱 cycle 5 的終點是第二個檔的 window 6400，時間為 2026-09-04T07:58Z，累計 192,148 秒即 53 小時 22 分，OD600 為 2.4474。Results 的 102.4 小時就是同一個檔的全長，OD600 由 0.831 到 3.770。Engineering 引用的起始 OD600 0.1738 出自第一個檔，因此 cycle 5 確實是 run 4 的前段，與指導老師的說法一致。

evidence.quote: Experiment 4

note_en: Both numbers are in the raw log Chars posted as Experiment 4. At window index 6400, timestamped 2026-09-04T07:58Z, cumulative flow reads 1,132,192 mL, that is 1,132.2 L, and transmembrane pressure reads -0.00045 bar, which rounds to -0.0005. That window is also where OD600 is 2.4474, so the end of the integration run means the end of the 53 h window and not the end of the 102.4 h file, where cumulative volume has reached 2,217 L.
note_zh: 兩個數字都在 Chars 以 Experiment 4 貼出的原始紀錄檔中。window 6400（時間戳記 2026-09-04T07:58Z）的累計流量為 1,132,192 mL，即 1,132.2 L，跨膜壓為 -0.00045 bar，四捨五入即 -0.0005。該 window 的 OD600 正是 2.4474，因此「整合運轉結束」指的是 53 小時視窗的終點，而非該檔 102.4 小時的終點（累計量已達 2,217 L）。

evidence.quote: Experiment 4

note_en: All six pressures and both transmembrane pressures are in the raw logs Chars posted as Experiment 4. The start values 0.2412, 0.1874 and 0.2133 bar with TMP -0.000703 sit at window index 171 of the first file, 2026-09-01T13:15Z, which is also the OD600 0.1738 point. The end values 0.2024, 0.2001 and 0.1976 bar with TMP -0.00045 sit at window index 6400 of the second file, 2026-09-04T07:58Z.
note_zh: 六個壓力值與兩個跨膜壓都在 Chars 以 Experiment 4 貼出的原始紀錄檔中。起始值 0.2412、0.1874、0.2133 bar 與 TMP -0.000703 位於第一個檔的 window 171（2026-09-01T13:15Z），也正是 OD600 0.1738 的那一點。結束值 0.2024、0.2001、0.1976 bar 與 TMP -0.00045 位於第二個檔的 window 6400（2026-09-04T07:58Z）。

evidence.quote: Experiment 4

note_en: The raw log contradicts this. In the 102.4 h file Chars posted as Experiment 4 the od600_bubble_pct column is non-zero in 4,374 of 12,259 windows, with a maximum of 42.9 per cent and a mean of 4.6 per cent; the very first window already reads 35.7 per cent. What does stay clean for the whole run is the od600_valid flag, which is true in every window, so the readings were all kept.
note_zh: 原始紀錄與此說法相矛盾。在 Chars 以 Experiment 4 貼出的 102.4 小時檔中，od600_bubble_pct 欄位在 12,259 個視窗中有 4,374 個不為零，最大值 42.9%、平均 4.6%，第一個視窗就已是 35.7%。整段運轉真正維持乾淨的是 od600_valid 旗標，每個視窗皆為 true，也就是所有讀值都被保留。

evidence.quote: Experiment 4

note_en: The one logged run uses two wavelengths and three intensity tiers, which matches the wiki, but not twenty-four positions with four replicates each. Timmy's 19 September log lists units 01 to 12 only: green at 100, 12 and 2 per cent across three units each, and single red units at the same three levels. The intensities being set in code is supported by Anton Lin's 16 July sketch, which drives three light pins with fixed analogWrite duty cycles.
note_zh: 唯一有紀錄的那次運轉使用兩種波長與三個強度階層，與 wiki 相符，但並非二十四個位置、每組四重複。Timmy 9 月 19 日的紀錄只列出 01 至 12 號管位：綠光 100%、12%、2% 各三管，紅光同樣三個強度各一管。強度以程式碼設定一點則有 Anton Lin 7 月 16 日的程式草稿佐證，其以固定的 analogWrite 佔空比驅動三個燈光腳位。

evidence.quote: Un 01-03 Green 100% ;
analogWrite(PIN_LIGHT1, 80);   // ~31% duty cycle

note_en: Discord supports the Uno R4 and MOSFET half of this. The 4 July hardware sheet names the platform as an Arduino Uno R4, notes that only the WiFi variant has WiFi, and gives IRLZ44N logic-level MOSFETs for LED switching with PWM analog modulation of the green and red LEDs. Anton Lin's LPA sketch drives exactly three light pins by analogWrite. The UNO Q, the shared sensor bus and the live web dashboard are not described in any message.
note_zh: Discord 支持其中 Uno R4 與 MOSFET 的部分。7 月 4 日的硬體規格表載明平台為 Arduino Uno R4，並註明只有 WiFi 版本具備無線功能，LED 切換使用 IRLZ44N 邏輯準位 MOSFET，綠光與紅光以 PWM 類比調變。Anton Lin 的 LPA 程式正好驅動三個燈光腳位。UNO Q、共用感測器匯流排與即時網頁儀表板則未見於任何訊息。

evidence.quote: - Platform: Arduino Uno R4 (Renesas RA4M1) — SUPERSEDES ESP32 in spec v0.1
- LED switching: IRLZ44N logic-level MOSFET (unchanged)
- LEDs: 520 nm green (CcaSR ON) + 660 nm red (CcaSR OFF), PWM analog modulation

note_en: The run itself is confirmed, the recipe is not. Timmy announced on 10 October that the two photometers were running the final calibration test, with V2 a cost-down light-fibre design, and posted a live 10/10 Photometer Calibration sheet; jacquelyn later confirmed the x axis is mg of SiO2 added and the y axis the OD600 sampled. No message states the 2.5 mg steps, the 100 mg ceiling, the 500 mL volume or the 1 per cent SDS.
note_zh: 這次運轉本身可以確認，配方則否。Timmy 於 10 月 10 日宣布兩台光度計正在進行最後的校正測試，V2 為降低成本的光纖設計，並貼出即時更新的 10/10 Photometer Calibration 試算表；jacquelyn 後來確認 x 軸為加入的 SiO2 毫克數、y 軸為量到的 OD600。沒有訊息提到 2.5 mg 的級距、100 mg 上限、500 mL 體積或 1% SDS。

evidence.quote: Our 2 photometers are running our final Calibration Test.
x axis is how much SiO2 (mg) added and y axis is the OD600 sampled

note_en: Discord confirms the 10 October comparison took place on both builds against the BioDrop but gives different headline numbers. Noah Tau and Joshua Hong spent the evening asking why the V2 build reads about one fifth of the BioDrop, and Timmy's reading on 11 October was that V1 has more raw light intensity but gets shaky at high OD while V2 is lower intensity, more stable and less sensitive. Nobody quotes a slope of 0.995 or an intercept of -0.07.
note_zh: Discord 證實 10 月 10 日確實以兩台裝置對 BioDrop 做了比較，但給出的主要數字不同。Noah Tau 與 Joshua Hong 整晚在追問為何 V2 的讀值約為 BioDrop 的五分之一，而 Timmy 10 月 11 日的判讀是 V1 光強度較高但在高 OD 時不穩，V2 光強度較低、較穩定但靈敏度較差。沒有人提到 0.995 的斜率或 -0.07 的截距。

evidence.quote: why is v2 1/5 of biodrop
V1 more sheer light intensity, but shaky when OD gets high

note_en: Discord uses a fourth scheme again, and it is the one closest to the hardware. Through September the team talks about prototype 1 to 4: jacquelyn drew prototypes 1 to 3 on 13 September and asked what was missing for prototype 4, and Chars answered about version 4 when describing the early September run. So the reactor that ran in early September was prototype or version 4 in the builders' own words, not prototype VIII.
note_zh: Discord 又用了第四套編號，而且是最貼近硬體的一套。整個九月團隊談的都是 prototype 1 到 4：jacquelyn 於 9 月 13 日畫出 prototype 1 至 3 並詢問 prototype 4 還缺什麼，Chars 在描述九月初那次運轉時回答的是 version 4。因此以製作者自己的說法，九月初運轉的反應器是 prototype 或 version 4，而非 prototype VIII。

evidence.quote: heres prototype 1-3 sorry im not done with 4 yet the dates might be wrong for prototype 3
In this version 4, we did not give pressure transducer a  filter.

note_en: Chars labels the early September logs Experiment 4, which lines up with the run 4 numbering on Results and not with Engineering's cycle 5. He posted the two raw CSV files for that run under that single label on 9 October, alongside separate files labelled Experiment 1 and 2 for the June tests.
note_zh: Chars 把九月初的紀錄標為 Experiment 4，與 Results 的 run 4 編號一致，而與 Engineering 的 cycle 5 不符。他在 10 月 9 日以這一個標籤貼出該次運轉的兩個原始 CSV 檔，另外還有標為 Experiment 1 and 2 的六月測試檔案。

note_en: Discord corroborates the contamination half of the open note. On 1 September Abby Tsai explained that the ACCD preparation had been filtered in the open lab area to remove impurities, that contamination was suspected during that step, and that every group given the ACCD treatment was now growing bacteria; from then on the extraction would be done inside the biosafety cabinet.
note_zh: Discord 佐證了備註中關於污染的部分。9 月 1 日 Abby Tsai 說明 ACCD 製備是在實驗室開放區過濾以去除雜質，懷疑該步驟造成污染，現在凡是施用 ACCD 處理的組別都長菌；此後萃取處理將改在生物安全櫃內進行。

evidence.quote: 現在發現有accd treatment 的都長菌。
